verbatim_quote.original: Manager reported ~5000 active proxies but only the top ones used by the balance proxy. Approved plan: consistent-hashing plus active health checks.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Manager reported nearly 5000 active proxies but only the top ones were used by the balance group. Approved plan: consistent-hashing plus active health checks.

extracted_decision.summary: Switch the Load Balance group to consistent-hashing with active 60s health checks so traffic spreads across all healthy proxies.
extracted_decision.rationale: Round-robin with lazy checks concentrated traffic on the top few proxies.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Active checks over ~7000 nodes add probe load (~120/s).
